style: HEEWON — webtoon figures × watercolor-oil world × minimal iconic × movie tenebrism. Night ground = black. Magenta #D8258C = real lamp/wet specular, never glow. Composed for 2:1 letterbox. No text.

shipwreck.set: Tsushima strait, night storm. One Silla hull: cream sail, blue crescent. Black water, rain spears, lightning as the only hard white. Chunchu in soaking magenta.

beats.layout: Mast folds as a broken diagonal across the frame (ONE device). Cream sail tearing down the blue crescent upper-right. Chunchu small at lower-left rail, hair whipped, mouth open shout. Rain streaks + sumi speed lines. Lightning rim on wet wood. ship_silla DNA.

beats.at: A wall of black water takes the deck
beats.layout: Black water wall fills 70% as a dark mass crashing from upper-left. Magenta sleeve and Chunchu face (wanting survival, not smirk) crushed against the rail in the lower-right third. Deck tilts. Foam white accents only.

Near-monochrome inverted flash: white lightning blanks the sky; tiny Silla hull (cream sail, blue crescent) a toy on black water, lower third. Chunchu a magenta speck at the rail. Monumental emptiness + one flash.

beats.at: The sea puts him on sand
beats.layout: Foreground: wet sand + magenta sleeve coughing water. Mid: Chunchu on hands and knees, hair plastered, wrecked face. Background: broken cream sail / hull dissolving in tide haze. ONE device: the wreck as a dark arc behind him.

beats.at: The men who pull him out of the surf
beats.layout: Spiral shield half-buried near lens (dark FG). Two Hayato (chest falcon tattoos; chief hawk headdress) haul wet Chunchu. He gasps — not dry, not smirking. Waterline bright slash. Torch bokeh on thatch far back.

beats.at: So he has been told that he is a person
beats.layout: Tattooed finger jabbing wet magenta chest as the hard line. Hayato shoulder FG left. Chunchu face hopeful/listening, rain-wet. Coal ember key.

beats.at: They tie his wrists to the post
beats.layout: Stake = vertical black divider. Chunchu BOUND (wrists tied), wet magenta. Chief crouches with coal on GREEN leafy wood; flame dies. Spearman + spiral shield in shadow right. Village thatch void.
Parting cord as bright slash mid-frame. Abe red cloak laughing left. Takutsu blade through cord right. Chunchu dropping to knees, hem smoking. Speed lines, no SFX letters.

faraway.set: Chang’an lesser guest hall at night. Daming-night DNA: vermilion columns, white balustrade echo, blue-gold lamp drama, crushed black floor. ONE carpet as warm island. Same carpet, same lamp, every still.
faraway.blocking: Carpet center. Chunchu magenta, facing the two guests. Tibetan (felt / highland court dress from ch_tibetan) on Chunchu’s right (frame left). Persian (green tall hat, pearl-roundel silk from ch_persian) on Chunchu’s left (frame right). Lamp on the floor near carpet edge, raking from below-side.

beats.layout: Carpet island in vast dark hall. Three figures: Tibetan LEFT, Chunchu CENTER leaning in fascinated, Persian RIGHT. Columns bokeh. Same blocking as bible.

beats.at: Gather the water into one road first
beats.layout: Tibetan fills midground — face+dress from ch_tibetan — hands open gathering water/herd. Chunchu eye FG hungry. One lamp. Hall void.
Persian face owns frame (ch_persian: green hat, pearl roundels, pointed beard). Ash-quiet. Magenta sleeve + Chunchu profile edge. Half-face shadow device.
Chunchu SMALL lower third on empty carpet, quiet laugh, wonder. 60%+ black hall negative space. Hall-axis wedge. Lattice shaft. No envoys.
